sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines 
the major maintenance procedures P1, to be performed every five years as 
indicated by Y5 in the title block.

This pump transfers the condensate from the hot 
well of condenser to the condensate preheaters then to deaerator then to the 
feed tank.
المواصفات الفنية

The first draft is initiated by eng. Mohamed Abdel Azeem, tested by eng. Mamdouh Ghazy, revised by eng. Samir Abdel Gelil: EDEPC 
inspection and quality control general director, accepted by eng. Mohamed Farag 
Anan: general manager, and approved by eng. Mohamed El-Sarrag: head sector of 
Damietta (3x135MW) PS.

تم قبول هذه الوثيقة من قبل المهندس.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC planning. & financial 
 predicting head sector and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
Isolate the CB of the pump motor.

Isolate the pump mechanically by closing 
 suction and delivery valves.

sections.text: التفكيك
Pump out of Operation
Check the alignment and record it.
Disconnect the motor

Unbolt the coupling between the motor and the 
 pump.
Remove the motor.
Dismantle every piping connecting to the pump.

Unbolt the pump from the barrel and take the 
 unit and put it on a clean stand.

Check the clearances of the pump before 
 disassembly of the pump.
قم بتفكيك محمل الدفع.
Dismantle the packing seal.
Remove discharge elbow.
Carry out the first bearing ( 515 ).
Dismantle the first column pipe ( 107 ).

Dismantle the screwed coupling ( 466 ) by 
 dismantle two shafts ( 403 ) & ( 404 ). Don't loose the locating pin (408), then remove the shaft ( 403 ).
قم بتنفيذ المحمل الثاني ( 515 ).

Dismantle the pump with last stage of the 
 impeller at first.
Remove the shaft sleeve ( 415 ).

Dismantle the fixations ( 1059 ) to extract 
 the last stage diffuser ( 101 ).

Unscrew the nut ( 4839 ) on a few threads& 
 hammer the nut slightly until unlocking the cone ( 483 ) to remove impeller.

Draw out impeller fitted upon its cone by 
 sliding it on the shaft.

قم بفك المسامير اللولبية (5119)، ثم قم باستخراجها 
 غلاف الشفط (511).

تحرير الصامولة (218) والحلقات (217) 
 219).
Draw out the key ( 440 ).
Draw the suction bowl ( 100B ).
Then the shaft sleeve ( 418 ) is free now.
Remove the shaft ( 404 ).

sections.text: تقتيش
تقتيش
تقتيش
Clean all parts of the pump.
تغيير جميع محامل المضخة.
Check all parts for any worn-out, replace the damaged.
Check all parts for cracks; treat the cracks by grinding or remachining.
Inspect the run-out of the shafts.
Change the wearing ring.

Measure the radial clearances for the pump by measuring the gap between 
 wearing ring of the diffuser and the distance sleeve on the shaft and adjust 
 them.
Grease the bearings of the pump.(type of grease is multi-purpose grease).
Change the packing seal between the shaft and the wear ring.
Repaint the casing against rust.

sections.text: حَشد
Clean all contact surfaces.

Mount the impellers and diffusers of the pump beginning from the delivery side 
 up to suction side as follow.
Fit the sleeve ( 418 ) on the shaft ( 404 ).

Cap the suction casing ( 100B ) over the shaft with its bushing ( 528 ) with 
 tape ( 5282 ) and wear ring ( 310A ).

Slide the tools sleeve ( 311A ), this one will be thrust to the bushing ( 528 
 ).

By using the nut ( 218 ), the first impeller (200B) fitted with taper ( 483 ) 
 will be thrust inside the stage diffuser ( 100A ).
قم بتجميع المحمل الثاني (515) المجهز ببطانته (5152).
Place the pin ( 408 ) on pump shaft.
Screw the shaft coupling ( 466 ) by assembly the two shafts ( 403 , 404 ).
Place the pin ( 408 ) on pump shaft.
Assemble the column pipe ( 107 ).
Continue these operations up to last bearing ( 515 ).
Check the clearances of the pump.
Reassemble the delivery elbow ( 102 ).
Reassemble the stuffing box ( 600 ) and set new packing seal.
Assembly the thrust bearing.
Measure and adjust the clearance of the pump.
Connect every piping connecting to the pump.
Assemble the coupling between the motor and the pump.
Fix support motor with fixation ( 5019 ).
Adjust the alignment between the motor shaft and the pump shaft and record it.
